typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		REQUEST_NUMBER as string,
		REQUESTED_BY_NAME as string,
		TYPE_COLUMN as string,
		PARENT_GROUP as string,
		CHILD_GROUP_NAME as string,
		CMDB_CI_NAME as string,
		SHORT_DESCRIPTION as string,
		IMPACT_DESCRIPTION as string,
		OPENED_AT as timestamp,
		STATE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		PRIORITY_DESCRIPTION as string,
		CLOSED_AT as timestamp,
		CLOSED_BY_NAME as string,
		AFFECTED_CI as string,
		SYS_UPDATED_BY as string,
		SYS_UPDATED_ON as timestamp,
		START_DATE as timestamp,
		ASSIGNED_TO_NAME as string,
		ASSIGNMENT_GROUP_GUID as string,
		ASSIGNMENT_GROUP_NAME as string,
		CATEGORY as string,
		CI_CLASS as string,
		END_DATE as timestamp,
		OPENED_BY_NAME as string,
		PHASE as string,
		PHASE_STATE as string,
		REASON as string,
		RISK_DESCRIPTION as string,
		SCOPE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		UPON_APPROVAL as string,
		UPON_REJECT as string,
		URGENCY_DESCRIPTION as string,
		CLOSE_CODE as string,
		CI_ITEM_GUID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(ImportDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		UPON_APPROVAL as string,
		AFFECTED_CI as string,
		OPENED_BY_NAME as string,
		END_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PHASE as string,
		TYPE_COLUMN as string,
		PARENT_GROUP as string,
		CATEGORY as string,
		IMPACT_DESCRIPTION as string,
		OPENED_AT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SCOPE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		REASON as string,
		CMDB_CI_NAME as string,
		REQUESTED_BY_NAME as string,
		REQUEST_NUMBER as string,
		URGENCY_DESCRIPTION as string,
		RISK_DESCRIPTION as string,
		importdate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PHASE_STATE as string,
		START_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLOSED_BY_NAME as string,
		SYS_CLASS_NAME as string,
		UPON_REJECT as string,
		SYS_UPDATED_ON as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLOSE_CODE as string,
		CI_ITEM_GUID as string,
		SHORT_DESCRIPTION as string,
		SYS_UPDATED_BY as string,
		ASSIGNMENT_GROUP_NAME as string,
		ASSIGNED_TO_NAME as string,
		CI_CLASS as string,
		CLOSED_AT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		STATE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		ASSIGNMENT_GROUP_GUID as string,
		CHILD_GROUP_NAME as string,
		PRIORITY_DESCRIPTION as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		UPON_APPROVAL,
		AFFECTED_CI,
		OPENED_BY_NAME,
		END_DATE,
		PHASE,
		TYPE_COLUMN,
		PARENT_GROUP,
		CATEGORY,
		IMPACT_DESCRIPTION,
		OPENED_AT,
		SCOPE_DESCRIPTION,
		REASON,
		CMDB_CI_NAME,
		REQUESTED_BY_NAME,
		REQUEST_NUMBER,
		URGENCY_DESCRIPTION,
		RISK_DESCRIPTION,
		importdate = ImportDate,
		PHASE_STATE,
		START_DATE,
		CLOSED_BY_NAME,
		SYS_CLASS_NAME,
		UPON_REJECT,
		SYS_UPDATED_ON,
		CLOSE_CODE,
		CI_ITEM_GUID,
		SHORT_DESCRIPTION,
		SYS_UPDATED_BY,
		ASSIGNMENT_GROUP_NAME,
		ASSIGNED_TO_NAME,
		CI_CLASS,
		CLOSED_AT,
		STATE_DESCRIPTION,
		ASSIGNMENT_GROUP_GUID,
		CHILD_GROUP_NAME,
		PRIORITY_DESCRIPTION),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
